items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: >> [(note)] These lifelong friends were interviewed in Los Angeles on September 3, 1995 by Monk Rowe.

ctx.x: In the 50’s and 60’s he became one of the most sought-after arrangers in the music business, writing charts for Ella Fitzgerald, Nancy Wilson and numerous other artists. He has worked in west coast studios as a composer and actor and produced numerous recordings with his own big band. Gerald has found time to teach at UCLA and continues to compose new music.
These lifelong friends were interviewed in Los Angeles on September 3, 1995 by Monk Rowe.

We’re filming today for the Hamilton Jazz Archive and we’re in California and we’re also in musician’s heaven, because today we have two giants of jazz music — Mr. Gerald Wilson and Mr. Snooky Young, who between them have accounted for some of the greatest recordings of trumpet music and also some of the greatest compositions and arrangements, and it’s a real pleasure to have you gentlemen here. Welcome.
